summary: iptables options: action append or insert, chain, chain_management to create/delete chains, comment, ctstate connection states, and destination address with masks and negation.
questions: How do I insert an iptables rule at the top instead of appending?
How do I create a custom iptables chain with Ansible?
How do I match established and related connections?
How do I add a comment to an iptables rule?
Is it OK to use hostnames in iptables destination?

answer_card.title: iptables parameters (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `action`: `append` (default) or `insert` (top); existing rules aren't modified
- `chain`: `INPUT`, `FORWARD`, `OUTPUT`, `PREROUTING`, `POSTROUTING`, or user-defined
- `chain_management` (false): create chain on `present`; delete on `absent` if only chain/table given
- `comment`
- `ctstate`: `NEW`, `ESTABLISHED`, `RELATED`, `INVALID`, ...
- `destination`: IP, network/mask, hostname (resolved once; avoid DNS names). `!` negates
